data.title: Peter Schiff Warns Of ‘A Black Monday’ For BitMine And Ethereum ETFs If ETH Loses Key Support
data.description: BitMine Immersion Technologies (BMNR) and Ethereum (ETH) exchange-traded funds (ETFs) may experience a "Black Monday" if the token breaks a significant support level over the weekend, Peter Schiff said on Saturday.Schiff made the call in a post on X, after an earlier warning on Ethereum.
